component: OpenEvals RAG_HELPFULNESS_PROMPT + output_schema + minimal Pi bridge
case_advance: Manual unblinded author audit after P01; structural/transport or material semantic failure stops all remaining calls. No automatic P02.

acceptance.P01: Identify A's unexplained personal-choice assertion without treating its absence in B as an automatic loss; shorter alone is insufficient.
acceptance.P02: Identify the actual mechanism in A and the explanatory gap in B relative to the request; more claims/longer alone is insufficient.
acceptance.shared: Record shared issues and uncertainty when supported; do not infer no shared defects from silence. Material invented claims or evidence are failures.

scope_limits: Development cases already labeled; not independent validation
Provider HTTP requests not directly instrumented; agent/provider retries disabled in isolated settings; only visible text/usage retained
Prompt schema is text-instructed in Pi bridge, not provider-enforced JSON schema
validation: Synthetic OpenEvals fixtures with in-process network denial, exclusive writes, scoped lint/type/format and whitespace; no full suite.
